description: The same statement said again after 210 newer live facts of the same scope. Limit: the duplicate check looks at the 200 newest live rows only (and without vectors compares text alone), so an old fact falls out of the novelty window. Failure means: the repeated statement is stored a second time (forbidden-fact-stored, class other), which also doubles it in recall; with an embedding model the run shows whether vectors close the gap. Maintenance: run with maintenance on or off; the seeded accepted records are reinforced or younger than 94 days, so maintenance does not archive them.
